name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents — covering the full software development lifecycle from spec to ship.

min_lines.title: Read guard threshold (lines)
min_lines.description: Files longer than this are blocked from a direct Read (main conversation, codebase-analyst, test-writer, implementer, personas) and routed to bulk-reader or a ranged Read.

main_write_max_lines.title: Max lines the main conversation may write per Write/Edit
main_write_max_lines.description: Larger writes in the main conversation are blocked and routed to test-writer / implementer / code-writer. Planning docs (*.md, tasks/, spec/, docs/) are exempt.

block_main_edits.title: Block all code edits in the main conversation
block_main_edits.description: When true, the main conversation may not Write/Edit code at all and must delegate. Start with false and switch after checking /usage.

test_path_patterns.title: Test file patterns (space-separated shell patterns, matched against /<path>)
test_path_patterns.description: Defines the test-writer / implementer boundary: test-writer may write only to matching paths, implementer may not write to them. Add e.g. */spec/* for Ruby or */jest.config.* to hand test config to test-writer.
